description: Ryan never asked for this life.

He never asked to lose his parents or struggle to find friends. No one gave him an option when he got punished for acting out. So, in light of this, he simply stopped. Stopped acting out. Stopped trying to convince people that he was a victim. After all, you don't get to pick the hand you're dealt, you simply get to choose how you play it.

This shattered reality draws him into isolation, but when the world itself comes crashing down, it's almost cathartic to think others are finally seeing the world from his point of view. Maybe he could even use his experiences to help others get through it... but that would be giving himself too much credit.
The world has a vendetta against him and he has no idea why. The only constant amongst the chaos—his will to endure.
